scope.comparison_scope: 20 statistics comparisons per scenario; 500 comparisons across the 25 scenarios

point_definition.unit: One point is one (scenario_id, metric, statistic) comparison between independently recomputed Parquet data and the matching exported XLSX <scenario>_STATS cell.

metrics.reason: Final project equity is the representative-selection metric and an explicit Stage 9C audit metric.
P1 is explicitly defined in the repository governance decisions and appears in the Stage 9C statistics audit.
P2 is explicitly defined in the repository governance decisions and appears in the Stage 9C statistics audit.
Final cash is a numeric end-of-trial accounting metric carried in the trial-level data and workbook statistics.

independent_verification.source_of_truth: Parquet trial_results dataset produced from the current execution; the workbook is a presentation/export artifact only.
independent_verification.calculation: Re-read trial_results.parquet independently after export, sort by scenario_id/trial_id, recompute each defined statistic, then read the matching values from the exported workbook's <scenario>_STATS cells.
independent_verification.equality: Exact numeric equality; no tolerance is permitted.
required_checks: Exactly 25 canonical scenario IDs are present.
Each scenario has precisely trial_ids 26..50 and 25 rows.
There are exactly 625 unique (scenario_id, trial_id) pairs and no duplicates.
The workbook has all 25 <scenario>_STATS worksheets and all four metric rows and five statistic columns.
All 500 comparisons are numeric, finite, and exactly equal.
The complete workbook contains 185 worksheets (10 global plus 7 for each of 25 scenarios).
No Excel error values are present.
The final workbook is explicitly bound to the cohort fingerprint in dataset_identity.json.
independent_verification.pass_rule: PASS only if every listed prerequisite and all 500 comparisons pass. Missing cells, missing/duplicate trials, identity mismatch, errors, or any numeric mismatch means FAIL.

selection_definition.P10_P50_P90: Select the trial whose final equity is closest to the corresponding quantile; ties use the smallest trial_id.
selection_definition.Loss_Case: Select the trial minimizing abs(Final_Net_Project_Equity); ties use the smallest trial_id.
selection_definition.Max_Case: User-authorized extension: select the trial maximizing abs(Final_Net_Project_Equity); ties use the smallest trial_id.
selection_definition.selected_details: Re-run each unique selected trial with event logging enabled; verify its final result exactly matches the initial cohort result and all daily balance differences are zero.

limits.interpretation: This gate establishes Parquet-to-XLSX statistics consistency for the requested 25-trial-per-scenario cohort only. It must not be represented as a PASS for canonical Monte Carlo sample-size, stability, or full Stage 9C acceptance gates.

source.original_literal_gap: The four requested fields, exact comparison points, and statistic-to-_STATS mapping were not completely named in the report.
source.user_authorized_semantics: 25 trials per each of 25 scenarios, five representative roles including Loss Case by minimum absolute equity and Max Case by maximum absolute equity.

cohort_scope: trial_ids 26..50 for each scenario; fresh cohort, separate from canonical 11,005-trial dataset and the interrupted prior attempt using IDs 1..25
